short_bio: Argentine footballer, eight-time Ballon d’Or winner and captain of the 2022 World Cup winners.
biography:
Lionel Messi was born in Rosario, Argentina. At 13 he moved to Spain to join Barcelona’s academy, La Masia, which paid for treatment of his growth hormone deficiency.

He played for Barcelona’s first team from 2004 to 2021 and won the Ballon d’Or in 2009, 2010, 2011, 2012, 2015, 2019 and 2021. He then spent two seasons with Paris Saint-Germain and joined Inter Miami in 2023, the year of his eighth Ballon d’Or.

With Argentina he won the Olympic gold medal in 2008, the Copa América in 2021 and 2024, and the 2022 World Cup in Qatar, where he was named the tournament’s best player.
